rounded.corners: object outer corners use CORNER_TOKEN (~1.6–1.7× outline); acute cues use ACUTE_JOIN (~1.25–1.33× outline), on the keyline; boolean cut terminals use CUT_JOIN (0.3× outline); star uses STAR_JOIN (~0.5×) so five-point mass survives
rounded.legacyRoundedPlan: The undrawn fillet proposal previously called Rounded (0.5–1× on Outline) needs a product naming decision
rounded.notOutlineFilter: Rounded icons are constructed from Rounded primitives, not offset Outline paths
